v.rationale: All three pass their suites and meet the 5s budget (≈4.4–4.5s worst case). impl-2 ranks last: its hand-rolled retry loop is less idiomatic, a malformed rate item crashes with a 500 instead of falling back (verified by probe), and it reports every carrier failure, not just the 401, creating alert noise. impl-1 and impl-3 are close: both use Http::retry with a precise when-callback and map 404/401 cleanly. impl-3 has nicer exception design (self-rendering UnknownPostcode, ShouldntReport) and digits:4, but leaves unused imports in Pest.php, doesn't prevent stray requests globally, and its tests incur real retry sleeps. impl-1 is the simplest and cleanest, with global preventStrayRequests and an explicit test that transient failures aren't reported, so it edges ahead. Both impl-1 and impl-3 pass through unvalidated rate items (minor).
